rationale: The trajectory shows the parser dependency update installing successfully and Babel compilation completing, followed by Mocha aborting while loading css-converter.js because CssSelectorParser is no longer a constructor. The final verifier also fails during module loading, although its truncated stderr omits the leading exception. This is a concrete source/dependency API incompatibility rather than a compiler failure or merely an inferred omission from the reference patch; incomplete-migration remains a broader alternative.
